sentence: This project studies how RNA and protein at synapses differ in neurons that degenerate, using mouse models and human assembloids.
This project studies how long-range GABAergic neurons in the hippocampus help coordinate activity with subcortical regions during memory formation.
This project provides resources to test genetic variants and to study metabolism and single cell omics in chronic kidney disease research.
This project tries to find out why CRISPR editing of an enhancer silences a gene in sickle cell disease and related blood disorders.
This project studies which RNAs control gene expression and chromatin in the human malaria parasite across its life cycle.
This project studies how allergens lead to disease-causing allergic memory in immune cells from allergic subjects.
This project tests whether stress reduction and mindful movement help Latinas meet and keep up physical activity guidelines.
This project studies what controls how spiral ganglion neurons connect to hair cells and how a genetic form of hearing loss affects them.
This project tries to find out which optical coherence tomography biomarkers predict treatment response and visual outcomes in uveitic macular edema.
This project tests an imaging agent that helps surgeons detect lung cancer tumors during surgery.
This project develops genetic screening methods to find transcriptional mechanisms that control lineage identity in human carcinoma and sarcoma models.
This project tests how paternal exposure to a toxicant changes small RNAs in sperm and disrupts embryonic development.
This project builds a system that runs molecular dynamics simulations relevant to epilepsy, chronic wound healing, and viral infections.
This project provides analysis of sequencing datasets, imaging, and clinical data using computational workflows for cancer research.
This project uses artificial intelligence models with extensive datasets to predict neuropeptides more accurately.
This project studies how factors inside and outside stem cells control the activity of epithelial stem cells.
This project uses in vitro models and high-throughput screening to test approved drugs for treating osteoarthritis.
This project develops and tests a tool that uses biomarkers to choose treatment for resistant late life depression.
This project builds a low-cost portable platform that uses CRISPR and fluorescent nucleic acid to screen for cervical cancer.
This project uses model systems and organoids to find out how gastric intestinal metaplasia and dysplasia, which come before gastric cancer, form.
